title: Honors Hours — Honors College Course & Enrollment Requirements Refresher
summary: 线上回顾 Honors College 课程与选课要求，由 Honors College Advising 与 Engagement 团队主持。
summaryEn: Review Honors College course and enrollment requirements with the Advising and Engagement teams in this online Honors Hours session.

title: Personal Finance Workshop & Community Service Drive
summary: 跟随 Desouvre 教授学习实用个人理财策略。请带笔记本电脑和一件 food pantry 食品；活动面向所有专业。
summaryEn: Join Professor Desouvre for practical personal finance guidance. Bring a laptop and a food pantry donation. Open to students of all majors.

title: Sensory-Friendly Halloween Cosplay Competition
summary: 在友善、包容的环境里参加万圣节角色扮演，认识同学。有免费食物、赠品与比赛奖品，面向所有学生。
location: Graham Center Ballrooms · A, B, C
summaryEn: A sensory-friendly Halloween cosplay competition with food, giveaways and prizes. Meet other students in a welcoming, inclusive environment.

title: FIU 2026 Pre-Health Volunteer Fair
summary: 了解医疗健康领域的志愿服务机会，与迈阿密和 Broward 的机构交流。尤其适合准备申请健康专业学院的同学。
summaryEn: Explore health-related volunteer opportunities and meet organizations from Miami and Broward, especially if you are preparing for a health professions program.

title: Honors College UK Study Abroad Info Session 2027
summary: 与 James Sutton 教授了解英国海外学习项目、课程、旅行安排和参加条件。面向符合条件的 Honors 各专业学生，可现场或线上参加。
sourceNote: 官方同时关联到学术讲座与职业中心两个选项；同一场经历只计一次，可在记录时选择类别。
summaryEn: Learn about the 2027 UK study abroad program with Professor James Sutton, including courses, travel and eligibility. Attend in DM 392 or online.

title: Career Cookies: Meet Your Honors Career Specialist!
summary: 认识 Honors 职业顾问 Adri，了解职业服务和活动，并获得职业问题的简短解答。
location: DM 353（页面说明另写 DM 363，请以原页面核实）
summaryEn: Meet Adri, the Honors career specialist, learn about career services and upcoming events, and ask quick career questions.
